title: Privacy-Safe Monitoring Verification
objective: Memastikan monitoring lokal tidak mengumpulkan manuskrip, lore, profil karakter, media, prompt, atau secret.
retention_documented: Aggregate counters remain local-only; bounded journal retention is 5000 entries and no production transfer is configured.
limitations: No production telemetry, public signing, hosted CI, hardware, or external adoption data is available.
